insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address of an unfulfilled order is updated. This change affects orders updated through the GraphQL Admin API. The recalculation is automatic and does not require any additional fields to be specified in the mutation.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware that taxes will be recalculated based on the new shipping address. This may impact the total cost of the order and any subsequent fulfillment or payment processing steps. To handle this change, developers can review their order update logic and ensure that any dependent calculations or processes are updated accordingly. The GraphQL Admin API will return the updated order with the recalculated taxes, so developers should verify that their applications can handle this change.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations for their orders, even when the shipping address is updated. This ensures compliance with tax regulations and provides a better experience for customers.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculation is crucial for merchants to comply with regulations and avoid potential penalties. This change ensures that Shopify's platform provides the most up-to-date and accurate tax calculations, even when order details change.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexibility in cart management. The updateCart standard action now updates cart attributes.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores. Agents can search catalogs, manage carts, and proceed to checkout.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores. Note that development stores don't include public environments.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, providing more flexibility in order management. Developers can attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps aim to better reflect real-world fulfillment operations, making it easier for developers to achieve Built for Shopify status.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities to the toolkit, including Vue bindings, allowing developers to build Shopify storefronts with more flexibility.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 is released, removing deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, and adding flags to avoid prompts in app config link.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making when approving requests.

updates.title: The shopify-account component for customer accounts is now a Theme Store requirement
updates.summary: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, enabling customers to sign in and manage their account directly on the storefront.

updates.title: createdAt is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions
updates.summary: The createdAt field is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions, allowing developers to use the date and time a customer account was created in Function logic.

updates.title: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes
updates.summary: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes, providing more accurate tax calculations for orders.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality, Hydrogen, and fulfillment services

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support is available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with stores. Oxygen is also now available on development stores for Hydrogen storefront deployment.

themes.title: Fulfillment and Order Management
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated. New fields are also available for cash management activities and drawers in POS.

themes.title: Hydrogen and Development Updates
themes.detail: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and the CLI has been updated to version 4.6.0 with changes to app configuration and dev session support.
